topic_title: Dangers of Speed and Street Racing Statutes
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.420, what is the criminal classification of street racing on a public road?

options.text: A standard municipal parking ticket settled through online city payment portals
Class B misdemeanor on first offense, escalating to a felony if injuries occur
A non-criminal administrative infraction with zero vehicle impoundment rules
Civil litigation matter handled exclusively between private insurance companies
